summary: Wisconsin's Commissioner of Insurance gave written notice on October 15, 2020 of a new basic loss ratio of 40% for credit life and new prima facie credit life rates for the three-year period beginning January 1, 2021. Single life: $0.38 per annum per $100 (single premium decreasing), $0.70 (level) and $0.585 per month per $1,000 (outstanding balance). Joint rates are 167% of single.
